# Play Mine

> Free high-resolution music streaming web application created by Sanchar Koirala, featuring instant browser playback, a 5-band sound equalizer, live audio visualizer, and listener song requests.

## Features
- **Free Music Streaming**: Instant high-resolution audio playback with shuffle, repeat, and timeline scrubbing.
- **Custom Sound Equalizer**: 5-band sound shaping (Sub Bass, Bass, Vocals, Clarity, Treble), quick audio presets, stereo surround width control, and volume guard.
- **Listener Song Requests**: Built-in request form allowing visitors to submit song suggestions with their email address.

## Canonical URLs
- `https://play-mine.pages.dev/`: Public music player and song request portal.
- `https://play-mine.pages.dev/manifest.json`: Progressive Web App manifest.
